# Learned instinct: ansible-no-log-on-secrets (confidence 1)

Any Ansible task that touches a secret value (retrieves from Vault, sets a password, registers a variable containing a token or key) must have `no_log: true`. Any task that passes a secret via template variables must also have `no_log: true`. This is a CRITICAL finding if missing on a PCI-scope system.

Source: PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req 3.4.1 (protect stored data); ansible-lint [no-log-password]
